criteria.criterion: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs adds an optional `sccache` entry to Tools holding only a version (no sha256 table), defaulting to absent, so the existing athena.toml still parses.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: `Tools` gains `#[serde(default)] pub sccache: Option<CratePin>`. `CratePin` has `deny_unknown_fields` and only a `version: String`. The test `sccache_pin_is_optional_and_holds_only_a_version` checks three things: REPO_CONFIG (the real athena.toml) parses with `sccache == None`, a version-only pin parses, and a pin with `sha256 = {}` is rejected.

criteria.criterion: athena.toml, defaults.toml, and other governance files are unchanged; no all-zero or placeholder digest is added anywhere.
criteria.evidence: That command printed nothing, so none of those files changed. `git diff HEAD~1 --stat` lists only CHANGELOG.md, README.md, env.rs, capability.rs, config.rs, paths.rs, decisions.md and xtask/src/main.rs. Reading the diff, no digest of any kind is added.
commands: git diff HEAD~1 --name-only -- athena.toml defaults.toml setup.sh rust-toolchain.toml .github

criteria.criterion: xtask/src/main.rs setup installs the pinned sccache (when configured) before building Athena, skips it if already installed at tools/sccache/<version>, and fails with a clear message if the install fails.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: step 4 `install_sccache` now runs before step 5 `build_and_adopt`. With no pin it prints a skip message. `install_sccache_at` returns early if `sccache_binary_in(home, v)` is a file. Otherwise it runs `cargo install --locked --version v --root <home>/tools/sccache/v sccache`. A failed install gets the context message "installing sccache v failed; fix the error above, or remove [tools.sccache]...". If cargo reports success but the binary is missing, that is also an error. The test `sccache_install_skips_when_present_and_fails_clearly` covers all of these paths with an injected runner.

criteria.criterion: Env value expansion supports an {athena_home} placeholder, and paths.rs derives the sccache binary path from the single pinned version.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: the expansion lives in crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs, not invocation.rs as the reading assumed, and the change edits it there. A new `expand()` replaces `{job_dir}`, `{side}` and `{athena_home}`, and `build` calls it with `paths::athena_home()`. paths.rs adds `sccache_root`, `sccache_binary_in` and `sccache_binary`, which all derive from one version string. The xtask install uses the same functions, so setup and the wrapper path cannot name different versions.

summary: The change passes all seven criteria; I found nothing blocking. It adds an optional `[tools.sccache]` version pin that rejects any digest, and the current athena.toml still parses. Setup installs sccache with `cargo install --locked` into tools/sccache/<v> before building Athena; it skips the install when the binary is already there and stops with a clear message when the install fails. Environment values can now use an `{athena_home}` placeholder, and the sccache binary path is worked out from the single pinned version. The reading expected the placeholder code in invocation.rs; it actually lives in athena-agent's env.rs, and the change edits it there. D79 records the decision with its alternatives and tradeoffs, marks D46's sccache exclusion as superseded, and defers changing athena.toml to a later job. The CHANGELOG makes no unverified claims. athena.toml and the other governance files are unchanged, and no digest was added. I ran `cargo test --locked`, clippy and fmt myself: all passed, including the four new tests. My only findings are two nits: no row in docs/enforcement.md for the new rule, and one long doc-comment line in env.rs.
